_comment: Maps your FACTS attendance codes (the 'code' field from GET /Academics/AttendanceCodes) to the categories this report counts. absent_codes / tardy_codes / cut_codes are counted in the matching column. ignored_codes are real FACTS codes that are deliberately NOT counted anywhere -- listing them here is what tells scripts/check_setup.py they were skipped on purpose rather than forgotten. Any code in FACTS that appears in none of the four lists is flagged by check_setup.py.
